systems.name: Oʻahu lunar nights
systems.description: A named night for each of the Moon's roughly 30 nights, as recorded for Oʻahu.
systems.uncertainty: Night order and names differ between islands and between the earlier writers; how a given night lines up with a modern date (which night the count starts on) has not been verified.

systems.name: Maramataka
systems.description: The Māori lunar calendar of named nights.
systems.uncertainty: Night names, their number and order differ among iwi; the numbered examples here are approximate reference positions from a composite account and are not authoritative for every iwi.

systems.name: Adaduanan
systems.description: A repeating 42-day ritual cycle on which Akwasidae recurs every six weeks, always on a Sunday.

cycles.name: Adaduanan
cycles.description: The 42-day cycle, counted here from Akwasidae (position 0) because that is the day the source dates.
cycles.anchor_note: All 8 published 2026 Akwasidae dates (2026-02-01 to 2026-11-22) fall exactly 42 days apart on Sundays, so one anchor reproduces them. Dates outside 2026 are extended by the same cycle and need confirming.

cycle_positions.name: Akwasidae
cycle_positions.meaning: Recurring Sunday ancestral and royal stool observance.
